about: Ground Curiosity drove in the boxwork, as a network for finding paths in the browser (A*). Built by scripts/prepare_safe_paths.py: drives resampled every 2 m, tracks within 2.8 m joined, ground steeper than NASA's 20 degree suit limit left out. places: [lat, lon, elevation m]; edges: [place, place, rover tilt deg, harder (1) or easier (0)].
